kind: defect fix — item (1): the /progress 401 was the hub's bare fetch, never the api
cross_ref: Supersedes the run-001 investigation disposition of item (1) ('INVESTIGATED, NO STATIC ROOT CAUSE — needs a live repro'); the run-001 directive is honored, see below.

audit.evidence_provenance: The original audit artifacts lived in download/ and were wiped by a sandbox recycle; the trail was rebuilt from code on the current tree (dfa5a93f), including re-verifying the api-side symmetry the run-001 investigation established.
audit.root_cause: apps/hub/src/lib/progress-server.ts fetched GET /api/v1/learners/me/progress with { cache: 'no-store' } and NO Authorization header — browsers never auto-attach Bearer tokens, so the request reached the api anonymous and the authz shell (routes/learner/progress.ts:36 requireAuth) answered 401 fail-closed. The client-side getToken() gate decided WHETHER to fetch, never HOW.
audit.api_symmetry_verified: ONE global auth middleware (apps/api/src/index.ts:179) + ONE authenticator instance feed every /learners/me router (learner :284, kg :307, progress :320) — same header, same verdict. The run-001 'mounting symmetric, no root cause' conclusion was correct about the api and aimed at the wrong side of the wire.
audit.sibling_symmetry: drill.ts:121, study-plan-client.ts:62, battle.ts:75 all set 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' explicitly — the bare projection fetch was the only unauthenticated call to a protected endpoint in the hub.
audit.do_not_blind_fix_directive_honored: The run-001 directive demanded a live repro before any AUTH-SEMANTICS change. This fix changes NO auth semantics: the api is untouched (fail-closed 401 for anonymous is the designed posture), and the hub fetch now carries the same header its siblings already carry. The mechanism is deterministic — a valid token plus the missing header fully explains 200-vs-401, and the 200ing siblings prove the token itself was valid. A full-stack browser repro remains available to the operator for belt-and-braces verification.
audit.live_repro_note: If the operator wants the belt-and-braces pass: signed-in demo session → hub devtools network → /progress now shows 'Authorization: Bearer …' → 200; the rings switch from the SIMULATED overlay to the server projection (the DC-7 tier engages).

fix.mechanism: projectionFetchInit(token) — Bearer header when signed-in, honest absence when not — wired into the fetch; the fail-open fallback posture unchanged (a genuinely stale token still falls back, disclosed)
fix.law_pins: 2 tests in progress-server.test.ts pin the wire contract (signed-in header present; null token → no header, still no-store) — the regression guard for the whole defect class

gates.tsc: error set identical to the main baseline (4 pre-existing env-dependent module-resolution failures in untouched files — diff of sorted lists empty with and without the fix; CI hub lane is the build of record)

session_note: Two mid-turn recycles reset the checkout to a 4008e6ce-era snapshot; the fix survived as working-tree edits and was re-derived onto dfa5a93f (origin/main moved #1173 meanwhile). The download/ SESSION-STATE was also wiped and is recreated in this lane's close-out.
handoff: Item (2) (#418) remains open — needs its own browser repro. The band card stays OPEN for it; the DC-7 projection tier hub-side (T-QA-RINGS-001) now engages end-to-end once a valid token rides the fetch.
